pairs.subject: markdown-vault
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/mcp_server/tools.rs:1496 keys the sidecar's note by slug(title) with no minted id, and :1513 then atomically replaces whatever sits at that path, with no divergence check. Two titles that slugify alike overwrite each other, and an MCP rewrite silently replaces a note the human edited. (The recorded quote-replace and truncating-write defects were FIXED in 48f2f2c0bc: :1507 yaml_quote, :1513 atomic_write.)

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/mcp_server/tools.rs:1496 derives the record's path from slugify(title) with no frontmatter id ("Note title (becomes the filename)", :1096), so 'Q3 Plan' and 'q3-plan' are one record, the same many-to-one clobber mod.rs:517 fixed for the sync lane. Emit side realized: :1507 yaml_quote.

src-tauri/src/mcp_server/tools.rs:1513 writes atomically (realized) but unconditionally over an existing note. The Brain's push path re-reads the disk and refuses to clobber a divergent vault edit (commands/obsidian_brain/mod.rs:617); the sidecar has no such check, so the human loses the tie.

src-tauri/src/mcp_server/vault.rs:21 is a hand-rolled sixth walker. Its own premise, that it 'cannot reuse commands::obsidian_brain' (:5), is now false: tools.rs:1507 already calls crate::commands::obsidian_brain. It should consume vault_fs::walk_markdown_files, not a copy that must be kept 'in sync with graph.rs' by hand.

src-tauri/src/mcp_server/vault.rs:42 admits every .md, including sync-conflict copies, with no name-pattern exclusion or report, so an AI search returns a note and its replication duplicate as two hits.
src-tauri/src/mcp_server/vault.rs:84 tokenizes note bodies for TF-IDF only; the sidecar extracts no links and builds no graph.
src-tauri/src/mcp_server/tools.rs:1225 dispatches only vault search and write_note; the sidecar runs no lint or repair pass.
src-tauri/src/mcp_server/tools.rs:1450 re-walks the vault on every query; no second store is derived or persisted.
src-tauri/src/mcp_server/tools.rs:1450 computes each answer from a fresh walk with no persisted derivation, so no reconcile trigger exists to choose.
src-tauri/src/mcp_server/vault.rs:84 scores the whole body as one field; there is no extract-and-strip projection whose partition could hold a hole.

pairs.registryProposal: editor-interop and vault-as-database both imply that an agent-facing write tool must not replace an existing note without a base-hash or existence check, but neither says so for a write keyed by a caller-chosen title. A sentence covering the tool-call writer (an MCP or agent write keyed by title) would have anchored this defect directly.

pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/obsidian_brain/graph.rs:484 still counts an orphan as any note with no backlink, while lint.rs:121 exempts entry points, so the Graph stats and the lint report give two orphan counts and neither declares its predicate. The recorded watcher leak also persists: graph.rs:778 spawns a debounce `loop` that never exits, and stop_watcher (:822) drops only the watcher.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/obsidian_brain/markdown.rs:17 yaml_quote escapes every scalar, with the round trip tested at :384; the id is minted and quoted at :112; the injective filename is at mod.rs:517; there are two path funnels (mod.rs:1489 resolve_vault_subpath, graph.rs:264 ensure_within_vault); atomic_write is at mod.rs:65.

src-tauri/src/commands/obsidian_brain/graph.rs:484 orphan_count applies no exemption, while lint.rs:121 applies is_likely_entry_point. The two counts differ on any vault with top-level notes, and no count names its predicate.

src-tauri/src/commands/obsidian_brain/lint.rs:87 silently `continue`s past a note it cannot read, yet :129 reports it in scanned_count, so a partially read vault still lints clean for that note's links. Directory-level Abort (:145) and the declared exemption predicate (:160) are realized.

src-tauri/src/commands/obsidian_brain/vault_fs.rs:38 WalkOptions makes depth, error policy and hidden-file handling explicit per caller; lint.rs:145 chooses Abort and graph.rs:128 chooses the skip/depth-12 defaults.

src-tauri/src/commands/obsidian_brain/mod.rs:353 hash-gates the projection against the sync_state ledger only. A mirrored note that is deleted or edited in Obsidian stays 'current' until the source row changes, and neither a reconcile nor a declaration covers it; the projected note (mod.rs:398) carries no 'generated, edits overwritten' marker. The two-way lane is realized (mod.rs:617 classify_push).
src-tauri/src/commands/obsidian_brain/graph.rs:103 is a 30s TTL under the watcher invalidation. Because the reconcile is not on the read, the time bound the technique requires is present.
src-tauri/src/commands/obsidian_brain/graph.rs:135 keeps each note's whole body as the searched field; no extract-and-strip pass splits the record, so no partition hole can arise.

src-tauri/src/commands/obsidian_brain/graph.rs:778 spawns an unterminated debounce thread per start_watcher call, and :822 drops only the watcher. GraphPanel.tsx:145 stops and restarts on every unmount, so each visit leaks a thread. The watcher does not name its reaper. Atomic write (mod.rs:65) and directory watching (graph.rs:772) are realized.

src-tauri/src/commands/obsidian_brain/vault_fs.rs:120 collects every .md, including sync-conflict copies, with no exclusion or report anywhere in obsidian_brain, and staleness reads mtime alone (lint.rs:72) with no in-band review date. A cloud-synced vault inflates the orphan count, and a fresh checkout silences staleness.
